# ffxf_api_keys (Data Source)

Lists the API keys of the account. Secrets are never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ffxf_api_keys" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `api_keys` (Attributes List) API keys. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--api_keys))

<a id="nestedatt--api_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `api_keys`

Read-Only:

- `assumable_roles` (List of String) Names of the roles obtainable through token exchange.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the key is enabled.
- `exchange_only` (Boolean) Whether the key can only be exchanged for a temporary token.
- `expires_at` (String) Expiry timestamp.
- `id` (Number) API key identifier.
- `ip_addresses` (List of String) Addresses the key is restricted to.
- `last_used_at` (String) Timestamp of the last use.
- `name` (String) Key name.
- `prefix` (String) Non-secret key prefix.
- `role` (String) Name of the role the key holds.
